name: @polymarket-bot/strategy-runtime
description: Deterministic strategy runtime (WP-170, handoff §9.6): immutable config loading, pure synchronous callback invocation with an injected-clock watchdog, exactly one persisted DecisionResult per callback (§6 invariant 3, ADR-005), deterministic seeded RNG, and versioned rebuildable state checkpoints. Pure layer-1 logic: no I/O, no wall clock, no ambient randomness; persistence is a port the composition root implements.
